Autumnal Aesthetics.description: Aesthetics related to the season of Autumn, often characterized by themes of harvest, change, warmth, and decay.

Spring Aesthetics.description: Aesthetics associated with the season of Spring, typically involving themes of rebirth, renewal, love, and blossoming nature.

Summer Aesthetics.description: Aesthetics connected to the season of Summer, often featuring themes of sunshine, vacation, heat, freedom, and vibrant life.

Winter Aesthetics.description: Aesthetics related to the season of Winter, characterized by themes of cold, coziness, holidays, quiet, and reflection.
